criteria.evidence: Explicitly recommends 'Create a read-only database role/user scoped to only the tables/columns the agent needs' and 'Apply least privilege at every layer'.
States 'No — don't use the admin credentials' and explains why granting unnecessary write/delete privilege is unsafe due to prompt injection, model error, and blast radius.
Instructs to point the tool at a read-only credential with only SELECT permissions, no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, and restrict API endpoints to GET/read only.
criteria.criterion: Restrict the tool to the minimum required authorization.
